main.description: Writes a new members record for an organization, with the entries behind its commitments. The caller must be an owner of the organization. The record counts once the previous record's owners' threshold attests it.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this host.

entries.description: The entries behind the record's commitments, which the host keeps private.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.
